history.method: Most recent 5 available prior-match records; role-minute share is sample familiarity, not ability. Zero-minute or absent records provide no usable denominator.

comparison.method: Equal clock windows; on_pitch_seconds reports actual player exposure. Unequal exposure and concurrent changes prevent attributing differences to the substitution.
